text: ok so im curious how do we get to where u can identify and make the operation in 2-3 tool calls max.
resolution: Defined the short Agent Seat path for restoring exploded detached parts: persist a compact detach-time home frame on the Outliner part, expose displacement/home status in look, and add one atomic part-reseat verb that resolves/selects/applies by stable part identity. Exact provenance gives look + reseat in two calls; legacy parts fall back to journal matching or refuse with scored candidates. Also identified the immediate failed selection as an incorrect part-select argument shape (partId instead of ids), so no geometry was moved.
